# #29 Slides view: blind QA report

**Verdict: FAIL.** 1 major (UX), 4 minor, 2 cosmetic. All 19 ACs pass. The Esc-in-fullscreen part of AC-29.12 is BLOCKED
because headless Chromium can't drive it.
Method: a throwaway prod stack and real Chromium, with scripts in `.verify/qa/29/` (`qa.mjs`, `qa2.mjs`, `q3.mjs`; results in
`results*.json`). Viewports: 1400×900, 820×1180 (touch), 390×844 (touch) and 844×390 (touch). Tested in all 6 themes.

## Acceptance criteria
| AC | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 29.1 | PASS | 4 slides with kinds title,content×3. Counter reads `1 / 4`. The header is absent and `.app[data-view=slides]` is set. |
| 29.2 | PASS | `---` splits slides, consecutive `---` drop out, `***`/`___` split, setext `B\n---` becomes a title (2 slides), and a `---` inside a fence does not split. |
| 29.3 | PASS | A `---` in a blockquote and a `## X` in a list item give 1 slide. H3/H4 never split. |
| 29.4 | PASS | Forward keys go 2,3,4,4,4. Home=1, End=4. ←/PgUp/Shift+Space/Backspace/↑ go back and clamp. Ctrl/Alt/Meta+→ do nothing. scrollY stays 0. |
| 29.5 | PASS | URL `view=slides&slide=3`. history.length 2→2, only `replaceState` calls. Reload opens 3. 99 opens 4. abc, 0, -2, 2.5 and empty all open 1. |
| 29.6 | PASS | `#b` opens slide 3. The fragment is dropped on the first navigation. |
| 29.7 | PASS | Aspect is 1.7778 at every viewport, centred, no horizontal scroll. Phone fills the width (390). Rotate hint shows on slide 1 only, for touch only. Its × dismisses it. |
| 29.8 | PASS | 60 bullets: font steps down (16.8px vs 24px base), the body scrolls (2133>720) and the wheel scrolls it. 5 lines: not scrollable. Canvas size unchanged. |
| 29.9 | PASS | hljs spans: 5, `code-copy-btn`: 1, `<table>`: 1, callout markup is `markdown-alert … data-testid=callout`. Mermaid renders as an `<svg>`, also on the last slide reached via End. |
| 29.10 | PASS | Click at 75% goes forward and at 25% goes back. Link, copy button, code block and drag-select all leave the slide unchanged. Phone tap and 100px swipe both work. Clicking `zoom-trigger` opens the zoom viewer and keeps the slide. |
| 29.11 | PASS | Esc and `slides-exit` both remove view and slide, keep other params, set `#far`, and scroll the heading into view (top 284px). No history entry. |
| 29.12 | PASS / BLOCKED | F puts `slides-root` into fullscreen, F again exits, and the button works. Esc in fullscreen keeps slides view, but headless Chromium does not route Esc to the browser, so the exit itself is unverified. Chrome auto-hides after 3s idle in fullscreen, comes back on mouse movement, and never hides when windowed. |
| 29.13 | PASS | "Say hi" is absent from the canvas and shows in the panel after N. Another slide shows `No notes for this slide.` Read view shows "Say hi". The panel sits below the canvas. The LS key is set to `"1"`, survives a reload, and is cleared on toggle-off. |
| 29.14 | PASS | `AGENT_SECRET` is in no slide DOM and no notes panel. A slide that only had agent content is dropped. |
| 29.15 | PASS | Locus light and dark: title background rgb(40,10,56), H1 white Montserrat. light, dark and both GitHub themes: title background equals `--bg-surface`. Locus-light content slide is white on an rgb(243,240,235) letterbox. |
| 29.16 | PASS | Print shows 4 slides at 1280×720, and counter, progress, notes, prev and exit are `display:none`. The PDF is 4 pages at 960×540pt. The last slide has `break-after:auto` rather than `page`, a literal deviation from the AC that avoids a blank last page. |
| 29.17 | PASS | HTML doc: the URL becomes `view=read`, the iframe shows, and `slides-enter-btn` is in neither the bar nor the overflow menu. |

| 29.19 | PASS | axe finds 0 serious/critical. Slide has `role=group`, `aria-roledescription=slide`, `aria-label="Slide 1 of 4"`. 1 of 4 slides exposed. Live region reads "Slide 2 of 4: A". Progress has aria 2/4 at 50% width. Tab order holds no hidden-slide elements. Keyboard-only (Tab to Present, Enter, →) works. |

## Other checks that passed
Header order puts Present after the view toggle and before copy-link. Tablet and phone put it in the overflow menu. Agent view shows it, edit
view doesn't. Back after entering slides goes back to `/library`. `?embed=1&view=slides` shows read view and leaves the param alone.
Review-mode doc: no comment UI in slides. Holding → (30 repeats) clamps with no errors. Space/Enter on a focused link activate the link and
don't navigate. Zoom open then → keeps the slide, and Esc closes only the zoom. Resizing to 900px mid-deck keeps 16:9 and slide 2. Live update
that removes the current slide clamps to 3/3. A later live edit keeps the index and shows the new text. Edge cases also passed: front-matter-only
doc (1 empty slide), doc starting at ##, two H1s (title,content,title), late H1, consecutive `---`, a notes-only slide (dropped),
400-char code line and 20-column table (both scroll inside the slide on desktop and phone). Theme flip on a mermaid slide re-renders the SVG
with dark fills.

## Defects
1. **MAJOR (UX): mermaid diagrams blow up to full canvas width, and their height overflows the slide.** A 2-node `graph TD` renders
   1225×1941 on a 720-tall canvas, so the slide shows a giant "Start" box and you have to scroll to find "End". A 9-node chain is
   1225×11456. Repro: `## Diagram` + ```` ```mermaid graph TD; A[Start]-->B[End] ```` then `?view=slides&slide=2`.
   Screenshots: `slide-mermaid.png`, `theme-github-dark-diagram.png`, `mermaid-slide3.png`. Read view upscales the same way
   (750×1189), so the cause is shared, but a slide can't absorb it. It technically meets rules 7 and 8, but diagram slides can't be
   presented. Suggested fix: in slides, cap the SVG to the space left in the body (`max-height`, `width:auto`) and don't upscale past its
   natural size.
2. MINOR: collapsible sections keep their fold control in slides. The summary shows a chevron, and clicking it collapses the
   section and hides the body. Rule 8 says "expanded with no fold controls". `slide-details.png`.
3. MINOR: a printed deck that contains a mermaid diagram gets a trailing blank page (11 slides give 12 pages, both themes; the 4-slide
   deck without mermaid gives 4). In print media `document.scrollHeight` is 7926 = 11×720+6. A visible `body > .mermaidTooltip` is
   the likely cause. `print-rich-locus-light.pdf`.
4. MINOR: after a live update clamps the current slide (5→3), the URL still says `slide=5`. Rule 12 says every navigation updates
   `slide`, so the deep link goes stale (reloading still clamps).
5. MINOR: AC-29.16 asks for `break-after: page` on every slide, but the last one has `auto`. The output is right (4 pages); only the
   wording differs. Reconcile the spec or the test.
6. COSMETIC: on a landscape phone (844×390) the canvas is 338px tall, not 390, because the 44px control bar takes the bottom.
   Rule 17 says "fill the height". `phone-landscape-s2.png`.
7. COSMETIC: on a portrait phone, body text on a 1280-wide canvas scales to about 5px. That follows from the spec, and the rotate
   hint covers it. `phone-portrait.png`.
